results.notes: Both backends produce a coherent night aerial; MLX selects a wider highway view while CUDA selects a denser city-center view.
MLX preserves one face and cafe setting across the sampled frames, but the person and camera distance differ materially from CUDA.
Both sequences contain a coherent running red fox; MLX uses stronger backlight and a closer, lower tracking composition.
Both sequences preserve a stable sunrise horizon and rolling surf, with different shoreline and wave realization.

release_interpretation: The four MLX outputs are usable quality examples, but this audit is not an independent blind review and does not establish same-seed CUDA perceptual parity.
